rules.title: .NET Core 1.0 is no longer supported
rules.summary: .NET Core 1.0 (Long Term Support) reached the end of its support on 2019-06-27. Microsoft no longer ships security or quality fixes for it. The same line applies to the SDK that carries it, so a global.json pinning an SDK 1.0.x is reported too.
